title: Monotone Increasing Digits
description: Given an integer n, return the largest number that is less than or equal to n with monotone increasing digits.
pseudocode:
1. s = String(n).split('').map(Number)
2. marker = s.length
3. for i from s.length - 1 down to 1:
4.   if s[i-1] > s[i]:
5.     marker = i
6.     s[i-1] -= 1
7. for i from marker to s.length - 1:
8.   s[i] = 9
9. return parseInt(s.join(''))

steps.note: Convert number 332 to array of digits [3, 3, 2].
Start loop from end. Compare index 2 (2) and index 1 (3).
Since 3 > 2, condition met. Mark index 2 and decrement previous digit.
Since 3 > 2, condition met. Mark index 1 and decrement previous digit.
Set digits after marker index to 9.
